issues.title: Atom C2000 LPC clock failure: unit may never boot again

detect.note: 02 = B0 (affected), 03 = C0 (fixed). CPUID 406D8 is the same for both. Board resistor fix is NOT detectable.

issues.mitigation: Resistor fix (about 100 ohm across header pins 1 and 6 on DS2415+); keep backups; avoid needless power cycles.

sources.quote: Parameter A0 SoC A1 SoC B0 SoC C0 SoC / PCI Rev ID 0 1 2 3

issues.title: Atom C2000 USB 2.0 device may not be detected at power-on

detect.note: No direct signal. Relevant because Unraid boots from USB. Intel's workaround is a January 2018 BIOS change; newest Synology BIOS M.211 is dated 2017/05/09.

issues.mitigation: Power-cycle if the boot stick is not found; nothing newer from Synology.

sources.quote: Workaround: An updated (January 2018) BIOS co de change has been identified and may be implemented as workaround for this erratum.

this_unit.measured: no matching dmesg lines in current boot

issues.title: Atom C2000 GbE may be non-functional after boot from mechanical off with WOL disabled

detect.note: Fewer igb interfaces than expected, or igb probe errors.

issues.mitigation: Cold reset from soft-off clears it (per Intel).

sources.quote: A subsequent cold reset from soft off (ACPI state G2/S5) will not exhibit this erratum.

issues.title: Atom C2000 GbE may hang on malformed IPv6 extension headers

detect.note: Whether in-tree igb carries Intel's workaround is not verified.

sources.quote: Workaround: Intel ® Ethernet Software release version 20.2 and above contains a workaround for this erratum.

issues.title: Dead CR1220 RTC/CMOS cell: unit does not power on

detect.note: 'dead' is meaningful, 'okay' proves little (kernel comment: ICH6 reports battery status using a different bit). Clock year before the plugin build year at boot = RTC lost time.

sources.quote: I took it apart and removed the battery. Battery tested dead as in 0V on an analog meter.
NOTE:  at least ICH6 reports battery status using a different (non-RTC) bit; and SQWE is ignored on many current systems.

this_unit.measured: batt_status okay; RTC clock 2026-10-25 at boot

issues.title: BC847 transistor (Q2/Q4) fails to pull PS_ON low: no power-on or random power cycling

detect.note: Unit does not start. DS2415+ not confirmed by any source found.

sources.quote: Replacing the Q4 transistor with another BC847B-G transistor worked like magic, and my DS1518+ has been operating without issue for 48 hours.

issues.title: 250 W PSU failure / new PSU will not start the unit

detect.note: No PSU telemetry reaches the host on avoton models.

sources.quote: Will not power on with verified brand new 250w power supplies, but works fine with a lower rated 200w taken from a DX513 extender.

issues.title: Marvell 88SE9215/9230/9235 DMA uses function 1 as requester ID

detect.note: Kernel quirk_dma_func1_alias handles it; only matters with IOMMU on.

this_unit.measured: 3 x 9215 rev 11, 1 x 9235 rev 11, no IOMMU

issues.title: Apollo Lake LPC/RTC/SD circuitry may stop functioning in outer years of use

detect.note: Synology states its designs follow Intel's July 2019 guidelines; Intel says B-1 meets quality goals for PC usage.

sources.quote: Designs that implement the LPC interface at 1.8V signal voltage are not affected by the LPC issue. Systems designed with a coin cell battery are not affected by the RTC issue.

issues.title: Drive firmware with a known vendor update

detect.note: smartmontools drivedb carries the per-model/firmware warnings; keep drivedb updated (update-smart-drivedb).

sources.quote: Previous versions of firmware with these models and part numbers are CC46, CC47, CC49, CC4C or CC4G.

this_unit.measured: ST1000DM003-1CH162 CC44, WDC WD1003FZEX-00MK2A0 01.01A01, no drivedb warning
